status: isolated candidate; not production deployment or end-to-end phone-control acceptance

official_asset.observed_download_note: Browser download endpoint returned HTTP 504; official release-asset API returned the exact digest verified archive. No alternate runtime was substituted.

runtime_requirements.version_integrity: Keep each release's full plugin and dependency set together; do not mix v0.9.3 and v0.10.0 libraries or headers.
runtime_requirements.root_network_isolation: On this test phone, su -c '/system/bin/unshare -n /system/bin/sh <script>' created a namespace with no routes; this is a test configuration, not an app-distribution requirement.
runtime_requirements.deadlines: Wrap each phone inference process in phone-local /system/bin/timeout with kill grace; host ADB timeout alone is insufficient.

limitations: Existing GUI-Owl Q4_K_M loads and gives the correct short text answer on HTP0; this does not qualify vision or app actions.
The pinned Hexagon backend supports K-quantized matrix multiplication and IMROPE, subject to tensor shape and layout restrictions.
The observed Qwen3-VL vision graph reports UPSCALE f32 as unsupported on HTP1, so CPU fallback is present.
One short debug run confirmed a v79 FastRPC session and HTP0 model/KV/compute buffers; DSP per-operation cycles were unavailable with a profiling warning 0x8000040e.
No claim that every operator executes on NPU, that two virtual sessions are two physical NPUs, or that 2048 context acceptance implies 8192 acceptance.
